description: Paraphrase Recall Gap pairs. stored_phrase is what an agent would write to memory after an incident; paraphrase_query is how a later, unrelated agent would ask about the same problem using different vocabulary. Pairs were written by hand to avoid shared word stems where a realistic re-phrasing allows it; where a shared token is unavoidable it is left in, because the bench measures reality, not a constructed worst case.
